title: Bhaasha, Bhāṣā, Zaban: A Survey for Low-Resourced Languages in South Asia – Current Stage and Challenges

bias_targets.methodology: Systematic literature review and quantitative analysis of NLP resource distribution (datasets, models, benchmarks) across South Asian languages and dialects to identify under-representation, resource scarcity, and performance disparities compared to high-resource languages and standard language varieties.

Reviewing existing multilingual evaluation benchmarks (e.g., MMLU) and machine-translated datasets to identify Western-centric concepts, cultural mismatches, and translation artifacts that distort evaluations in South Asian contexts.

Synthesizing literature on existing NLP resources and machine translation systems to highlight gender under-representation and the perpetuation of gender stereotypes (e.g., occupational stereotypes in Nepali-English MT).
Analyzing existing datasets and literature to identify caste and socioeconomic under-representation within South Asian NLP resources.
